description:
This notice is posted to communicate questions that arose from industry in response to the Draft RFP SPRHA1-26-R-1003 posted for this effort and the answers to those questions.

DLA and the Air Force will be conducting one-on-one Q&A sessions the week of March 30th.  Please contact DLA Contracting Officer Nathan Flinders to schedule a time.  Meetings will be scheduled for one hour and will be held via Microsoft Teams.
